guide.tagline: WAPDA Employees Cooperative Housing Society, next to Johar Town
amenities: Parks and mosques in every block
guide.overview:
Wapda Town is the WAPDA Employees Cooperative Housing Society in south Lahore, next to Johar Town. It is a fully built and lived-in society.

Phases

Wapda Town is laid out in Phase 1 and Phase 2, each divided into lettered blocks with their own parks and markets.

Buying in Wapda Town

Browse the houses and plots for sale and rent in each phase below, and call or WhatsApp the dealer directly.

faqs.a: In south Lahore, next to Johar Town and close to Khayaban-e-Jinnah.

faqs.q: How many phases does Wapda Town have?
faqs.a: Two: Phase 1 and Phase 2, each divided into lettered blocks.
